1970.notes: 16% of the federal tax computed at the federal rates in effect Dec 31, 1963 (AS 43.20.010(a) as re-enacted by ch. 69 SLA 1965, retroactive to 1964); schedule is the explicit one in ch. 10 SLA 1964 (= 16% x 1963 federal rates). Applied to federal taxable income, so deduction = federal personal exemptions; the federal percentage standard deduction/low-income allowance is not modelled. Federal 1970 surcharge does not apply (1963 rates). $10 school tax per wage earner not modelled.

1975.notes: Graduated schedule of AS 43.20.011 (ch. 70 SLA 1975, retroactive to Jan 1, 1975) on federal taxable income; deduction = federal $750 exemptions, federal percentage standard deduction not modelled. 9.5% maximum rate on earned income (IRC 1348 via ch. 125 SLA 1976, retroactive to 1975) not modelled. Head-of-household schedule exists. $10 school tax not modelled.

1976.notes: Graduated schedule of AS 43.20.011 (ch. 70 SLA 1975, retroactive to Jan 1, 1975) on federal taxable income; deduction = federal $750 exemptions, federal percentage standard deduction not modelled. 9.5% maximum rate on earned income (IRC 1348 via ch. 125 SLA 1976, retroactive to 1975) not modelled. Head-of-household schedule exists. $10 school tax not modelled.

1977.notes: AS 43.20.011 schedule (ch. 70 SLA 1975) unchanged. Ch. 8 SLA 1978 allowed a minimum deduction equal to the federal zero bracket amount ($2,200/$3,200), retroactive to 1977 (for 1977 given as a refund), plus $750 federal exemptions. 9.5% maximum rate on earned income not modelled. $10 school tax not modelled.

1978.notes: AS 43.20.011 schedule (ch. 70 SLA 1975) unchanged. Ch. 8 SLA 1978 allowed a minimum deduction equal to the federal zero bracket amount ($2,200/$3,200), retroactive to 1977 (for 1977 given as a refund), plus $750 federal exemptions. 9.5% maximum rate on earned income not modelled. 1978 individual credit of $100 (first year filing; more in later years, ch. 144 SLA 1978) not modelled. $10 school tax not modelled.
